policies.fossil: P63 combined fossil normalized by available eligible EPA gross zone shares; gross shares do not measure net zonal generation
policies.mapping: 2019 crosswalk continuity and explicit2025 facility zones; many-to-many identifiers annotate, never duplicate MW
policies.nuclear: NRC daily availability times seasonal EIA capability, normalized to P63; previous report before08:00 Eastern
policies.hydro: monthly conventional baseline and finite HY/PS headroom; no reservoir or pumping schedule; EIA annual-respondent months are estimates
policies.wind: EIA active capacities, identical statewide capacity factor assumption; SouthFork is a subset of K, never additional
policies.other: EIA active capacity with geometric daylight for solar; category/BTM coverage remains approximate
policies.inventory: 2025 early release; OP/SB eligible, OA/OS excluded; start-month excluded until next month, retirement-month excluded
policies.qualification: time/source/share arithmetic only; qualified prior is not a solved or capability-qualified dispatch
